decisions.reason: As a newly launched identity-related feature that fits the firm's secure-platform architecture, it is likely to be retained while management uses organisational slack to wait for clearer adoption signals.

Although payment-wallet offerings face tough aspiration benchmarks and uncertain early traction, its close fit with the firm's identity-plus-payment strategy makes retention more likely than withdrawal.

Because this NFC-based authenticator appears more niche and less central to the firm's flagship super-app platform, a shortfall against aspirations would likely trigger reallocation of resources away from it.
A secure payment and wallet framework directly supports the firm's ecosystem platform logic and its dedicated presentation suggests commitment sufficient to keep it on the market.
As the firm's stated flagship and strategic direction, this product is well below any realistic drop threshold even if early results are still developing.
This security library draws on the firm's long-standing application-security capabilities and is likely to be kept as a complementary core offering unless results deteriorate sharply.
